accepted.s: Visakhapatnam is governed by which of the following urban local bodies?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is governed by the Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation, commonly abbreviated as GVMC.
accepted.tq: Test the exact local-government body associated with a major city.
accepted.sec: Urban centres of AP - largest cities, cities above one lakh (2011), municipal corporations  [APPSC]

accepted.s: As per the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission answer key for 2011 data, how many cities of Andhra Pradesh had a population of more than one lakh?
accepted.x: The APPSC-GS 2019 answer key gives the number of Andhra Pradesh cities with more than one lakh population in 2011 as 32.
accepted.tq: Separate the population-count figure from the figures for municipal corporations, municipalities and nagar panchayats.
accepted.sec: Urban centres of AP - largest cities, cities above one lakh (2011), municipal corporations  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding urban local bodies in Andhra Pradesh according to the AP Survey 2025-26:
1. Andhra Pradesh has 17 Municipal Corporations.
2. Andhra Pradesh has 76 municipalities.
3. Andhra Pradesh has 30 nagar panchayats.
4. The total number of these urban local bodies is 123.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct: 17 Municipal Corporations, 76 municipalities and 30 nagar panchayats together make 123 urban local bodies.
accepted.tq: Check whether the component figures add up to the stated total.
accepted.sec: Urban centres of AP - largest cities, cities above one lakh (2011), municipal corporations  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following cities is NOT included among the main growth poles identified for Andhra Pradesh along with Visakhapatnam and Amaravati?
accepted.x: The listed growth poles include Vijayawada, Guntur, Nellore, Kurnool, Rajamahendravaram, Tirupati and Kakinada, together with Visakhapatnam and Amaravati. Warangal is not included in that list.
accepted.tq: Find the city that falls outside the specifically listed group rather than relying on general prominence.
accepted.sec: Urban centres of AP - largest cities, cities above one lakh (2011), municipal corporations  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists:

List-I (Economic Region)
A. Visakhapatnam Economic Region

C. Tirupati Economic Region

List-II (Description)
1. One of the three economic regions identified under Swarna Andhra @2047
2. Planned with NITI Aayog and projected to have a USD 750–800 billion economy by 2047
3. One of the three economic regions identified along with Visakhapatnam and Amaravati

Codes:

accepted.s:
Match the following nicknames with the corresponding cities:

List-I (Nickname)
A. City of Destiny
B. Andhra Paris
C. Temple City
D. Cultural Capital of the Andhras

List-II (City)
1. Tirupati
2. Tenali
3. Visakhapatnam
4. Rajamahendravaram

Codes:
A  B  C  D
 a. 3  2  1  4
 b. 2  3  4  1
 c. 3  1  2  4
 d. 4  2  1  3
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is the City of Destiny, Tenali is Andhra Paris, Tirupati is the Temple City and Rajamahendravaram is the Cultural Capital of the Andhras.
accepted.tq: Begin with the sure nickname–city pair and use elimination for the remaining pairs.
accepted.sec: City nicknames → city  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The title ‘Cultural Capital of the Andhras’ associated with Rajamahendravaram is linked to which historical court?
o: The court of Pulakesin II of the Chalukyas
The court of Rajaraja Narendra of the Eastern Chalukyas
The court of Gautamiputra Satakarni of the Satavahanas
The court of Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara Empire
accepted.x: Rajamahendravaram, also known as Rajahmundry, received the title in connection with Rajaraja Narendra’s Eastern Chalukya court.
accepted.tq: Apply the wrong-ruler trap by matching the title with the correct historical court.
accepted.sec: City nicknames → city  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is known as the ‘People’s Capital’ of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Amaravati is known as the People’s Capital of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Test a specific nickname against other prominent cities of the State.
accepted.sec: City nicknames → city  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following sets contains all the Smart Cities of Andhra Pradesh listed under the Smart Cities Mission?
accepted.x: The Smart Cities of Andhra Pradesh are Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Tirupati and Amaravati.
accepted.tq: Check the complete membership of a State-wise scheme list rather than identifying only one city.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Smart Cities Mission:
1. It was launched in June 2015.
2. It covered 100 cities.
3. The central share was ₹48,000 crore.
4. Its implementation was extended to 2025-26.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Smart Cities Mission was launched in June 2015 for 100 cities, with a central share of ₹48,000 crore, and was extended to 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Treat dates, coverage, financial allocation and extension period as separate statement checks.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the HRIDAY town in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Amaravati is the heritage city covered in Andhra Pradesh under HRIDAY.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the heritage-city scheme from the Smart Cities and AMRUT city lists.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to AMRUT, consider the following statements:
1. It was launched in 2015.
2. It covered 485 cities.
3. Its financial outlay was ₹1 lakh crore.
4. Its implementation was extended up to September 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. AMRUT was launched in 2015, covered 485 cities, had an outlay of ₹1 lakh crore and was extended to September 2025.
accepted.tq: Verify each scheme attribute independently, especially the date and extension deadline.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The cities covered under AMRUT in Andhra Pradesh are primarily identified on the basis of which criterion?
o: Only statutory towns with a population below one lakh
All villages with population below one lakh
Urban local bodies with one lakh or more population, along with eligible capitals and HRIDAY cities
accepted.x: AMRUT covers urban local bodies with a population of one lakh or more, as well as capitals and HRIDAY cities. It is not restricted to Smart Cities.
accepted.tq: Apply the eligibility rule to distinguish AMRUT coverage from the separate Smart Cities Mission.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The principal target of SBM-U 2.0, implemented during October 2021–2026, is to provide which status to all cities?
accepted.x: SBM-U 2.0 aims to give all cities Garbage Free status by 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the scheme’s defining objective to distinguish it from HRIDAY, AMRUT and Smart Cities.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In the AMRUT Ease of Living Index, 2018, Andhra Pradesh was followed by which two States in the ranking?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first, followed by Odisha and Madhya Pradesh in the AMRUT Ease of Living Index 2018.
accepted.tq: Test the precise order of States rather than merely identifying the top-ranked State.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs was included among the top-ten cities in the Economic Survey 2025-26 ease-of-living list?
accepted.x: Tirupati and Vijayawada were included in the top-ten ease-of-living cities listed in the Economic Survey 2025-26.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact pair appearing in a ranked list and avoid substituting other major cities.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP → cities covered (HRIDAY, Smart Cities, AMRUT, SBM-Urban, Garbage Free Cities)  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under PMAY-U in Andhra Pradesh, which of the following figures correctly represents the number of houses covered across urban local bodies?
accepted.x: PMAY-U in Andhra Pradesh covers 18,01,840 houses across 125 urban local bodies and 21 Urban Development Authorities.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its complete house, ULB and UDA figures rather than borrowing figures from other programmes.

accepted.s: DJAY-S, described as a new urban poverty mission, was piloted in which two Andhra Pradesh cities?
accepted.x: The DJAY-S pilot cities in Andhra Pradesh were Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Associate the pilot programme with its exact city pair and avoid confusing it with Smart Cities coverage.

accepted.s: How many Anna Canteens were reported to be functioning across the urban local bodies of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: There were 204 Anna Canteens functioning across the urban local bodies of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Separate the service-count figure from the counts of ULBs, AMRUT cities and PMAY-U ULBs.

accepted.x: Indore topped the 10 lakh-plus Super Swachh League in Swachh Survekshan 2024-25.

accepted.s: Which of the following activities is associated with the Smart City works in Visakhapatnam?
o: Integrated command centre and intelligent traffic
Construction of heliports by the Kakinada Smart City Corporation
accepted.x: The Smart City works in Visakhapatnam included an integrated command centre and intelligent traffic systems. Heliports are associated with the Kakinada Smart City Corporation, while DJAY-S was piloted in Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Use the city-specific project association to separate similar urban initiatives.

accepted.s: The Kakinada Smart City Corporation built which of the following?
accepted.x: The Kakinada Smart City Corporation built heliports. Integrated command centre and intelligent traffic works are associated with Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Directly discriminate between the city-specific Smart City projects of Kakinada and Visakhapatnam.
